name: ZenterestPriceFeed serves stale prices for abandoned markets
summary: ZenterestPriceFeed kept serving long-stale prices for the abandoned MPH and WHITE markets of this Compound fork, so 21,200 MPH supplied as collateral, overvalued at its old price, borrowed the zenWHITE market's entire 4.91 WHITE.
notes: The price feed is unchanged since its deployment 3.6 years earlier. Loss is the zenWHITE market's WHITE; the MPH collateral the attacker left behind is not subtracted (rule 11).
